newsitem.title: USA: ASV stake raised by Florida investor.
newsitem.headline: ASV stake raised by Florida investor.

text.p: Jacksonville, Fla., investor James Dahl said Tuesday he raised his stake in ASV Inc to the equivalent of 10.1 percent or 340,006 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Dahl said he bought 77,800 additional shares of ASV between November 6 to December 19 at prices ranging from $20.625 to $27.25 a share.
Dahl said his stake includes 90,000 shares issuable upon exercise of outstanding warrants and 60,606 shares issuable upon conversion of subordinated debentures of ASV that he holds.
He said had been elected to fill a seat in the ASV board at a meeting recently.
ASV is a Grand Rapids, Mich., maker and seller of track-driven all-purpose vehicles and related attachments.
